text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but repeated profit-taking can cut short potential gains; I should sell based on the investment case and portfolio needs, not the urge to lock in gains.","I held Stock C through a severe decline before selling at a large loss. I should review whether my reasons for owning a stock still hold and act on clear risk limits instead of avoiding the pain of realizing a loss.","My account’s recent losses show that individual trade outcomes do not tell the whole story. I should manage overall concentration and downside risk, and make decisions consistently rather than react to short-term performance."]}
